## 📋 Module Overview

This module offers hands-on practice in both **Python** and **Java**, two of the most widely used languages in industry and academia.

## 📚 Course Structure

::: {.callout-note}
## Module Contents — Python Track
- **P1** — Python Syntax, Data Types, and I/O
- **P2** — Lists, Dicts, Sets, and Tuples
- **P3** — Functions, Lambdas, and Comprehensions
- **P4** — File Handling and Exceptions
- **P5** — Standard Library and Popular Packages (NumPy, Pandas intro)
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Module Contents — Java Track
- **J1** — Java Environment, Syntax, and Types
- **J2** — OOP in Java: Classes, Interfaces, and Inheritance
- **J3** — Collections Framework
- **J4** — Exception Handling and I/O
- **J5** — Introduction to Threads and Concurrency
:::
